newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Gilts looking for prop at 113-30.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Gilts looking for prop at 113-30.

text.p: September gilt futures on LIFFE are likely to pull back and test support around Friday's low of 114-16, technical analysts said on Monday.
Philip Gardiner, analyst at Technical Data in London, said the contract was likely to head lower in the medium term but added any dips to 113-30, the bottom of a congestion area, should be bought.
"The outlook is bearish. Most technical oscillators are falling," Gardiner said.
By 0722 GMT, the September contract was quoted 4/32 down on the day at 114-20.
Gardiner said 113-30, the bottom of the end-June early-July range, was a medium term target which should prove supportive if September loses its foothold at 114-12.
"If we decide to go up, the top of that range which is 115-05 will be a very strong level," Gardiner said, noting the September contract had failed several tests of that level in recent weeks.
In the unlikely event of a break through 115-05, the high on July 17 and July 2, gilts could get a quick lift to 115-20 and 116-13 which are the next resistance levels, Gardiner added.
Nicholas Rose, technical analyst at 4CAST in London had a more neutral stance and said the market was oscillating in a broad range between 114-00 and 115-00.
The early bias would be for the downside but any dips would be part of that range trading, he said.
Rose expected support to come in at 114-16 and 114-11, the high on July 15. Then the September contract should see a bounce to 114-24/27, which is around the close on Friday.
At the short-end, December short sterling was quoted unchanged from Friday at 92.58.
